set.body:
Apply the owner's admission-hash decision (sibling decision bead).

- One key: read the three hashes from the record, delete the literals, and keep a test that pins the annotation hash value.
- Two keys: keep the literals and the agreement test, and write the reason into the Scaladoc so a later reader does not "fix" the duplication.

Either way, cite the decision and its reason in the code.
set.title: C1: apply the admission-hash decision to MediaManifest
